lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial density of smaller spots in the anterior section transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the lateral mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance contrast with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance blobs distributed across the entire silhouette, with a localized cluster of higher intensity spots along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible as dark, elongated silhouettes attached to the ventral surface and near the insertion point of the pectoral fin.
